purpose: Reference and test material for the press-conference agents. No prompt reads this file.

method.turn_split: Q./Question:/REPORTER: markers, else uppercase SPEAKER: lines, else question-mark heuristic
method.follow_up: explicit marker, or >=2 shared content words, or a short interrogative probe sharing a content word
method.classification: keyword vote per question/answer type; ties go to the earlier taxonomy entry; no hit is CLARIFICATION or OTHER
method.note: Transcripts are local and git-ignored; only these derived counts are committed.

INJURY.description: A player's health, availability, injury or practice status.

ROSTER_PERSONNEL.description: Who starts, who plays, depth, rotation, signings, releases or trades.

SCHEME_ADJUSTMENT.description: Scheme, coverage, protection, play calls and halftime adjustments.

PLAYER_PERFORMANCE.description: One player's game, usage or development.

TEAM_EXECUTION.description: The team's execution: turnovers, penalties, third down, red zone, run/pass game.

COACHING_DECISION.description: A specific game-management choice: fourth down, clock, timeout, challenge.

OPPONENT_NEXT.description: The opponent just played, or the next game and its preparation.

SEASON_CONTEXT.description: Standings, playoffs, streaks, records and where the season is going.

EMOTION_STORY.description: How the coach feels, what the result means, and the human story.

FRONT_OFFICE_CONTRACT.description: Job security, contracts, ownership, the front office and the future.

PERSONAL_MILESTONE.description: Records, milestones, history, a return home or a career marker.

OFFICIATING.description: Officials, flags, replay reviews and disputed calls.

GAME_MOMENT.description: A specific play, drive, series or moment in the game.

CLARIFICATION.description: A short clarification, clarification probe or question that fits no other type.

CREDIT_PLAYERS.description: Credits the players, a unit or a specific performance.

TAKE_BLAME.description: Puts the loss or a mistake on himself.

DEFLECT.description: Deflects: watch the tape, no update, can't speak to that.

ACCOUNTABILITY.description: Names the problem: mistakes, turnovers, penalties, not good enough.

SCHEME_TECHNICAL.description: Explains the football: scheme, coverage, protection, adjustments.

EMOTION.description: An emotional register: proud, frustrated, excited, tough.

CLICHE.description: A stock football phrase: one game at a time, next man up, do our job.

OTHER.description: An answer that fits no other answer type.
